status: MODELED: positions, boxes, cable ODs and the shaft geometry ASSUMED; ratings from logged datasheets
decisions: Audio: magnet-free SMD piezo in bridge drive on HB2 (rf2_audio.py); tones 3.0-7.6 kHz, equalised; AU1 class-D + speaker removed

Power switching: BQ76952 DSG high-side switch is the main switch; the power button wakes it on TS2 (falling edge, datasheet 7.x 'Wake on TS2'), the pod MCU turns it off over I2C after a 2 s hold; PM2 soft latch and LTC4365 removed (keyed MT60 prevents reverse charge)
TX driver placement: by an echo search along the shaft (s 255-345 mm, drift 0.1 x noise); the baseline 'neck at the shaft base' fails by about 100 x

Continuous boost thermal: the clamp energy (8.9 W boost) returns to the pack through a hysteretic buck in the PACK (no ferrite near the coil); the TXD keeps only the switch's 6.1 W on its heat sink (TJ 101 C, rf2_continuous); 460 V DC runs up the shaft in one FEP twisted pair at about 23 mA
Pack: 7S2P Molicel P30B (151 Wh) under the forearm as the head's counterweight
Inputs: one switch part (C&K KSC2 TE, IP67) for power, trigger and the two selector cams; no magnet in the pod (no offset at REF3 / the upper fluxgate)
TXD temperature: TMP117 in therm mode with EEPROM-stored limits drives the TXSTAT fault line; the head backs the boost off (no I2C to the TXD)
Link: RS-485 class pair (DATA+-) from CB1D to the pod; the head schedules LED frames and audio events on one clock and both play them a fixed 20 ms later (rf2_display3 coupling holds across the link)

TXD.note: TX driver beside L1 (+Y), heat-sink vents outward; position from the echo search (rf2_upper housing)

REF3.note: 3-axis reference as a sleeve on the tube (rf2_ref3 sleeve: saddle pairs + solenoid)

POD.note: upper unit: grip head + pistol grip (rf2_upper.py)

PACK.note: battery cartridge in the bay under the spine, behind the grip (rf2_upper.py)

tube.material: narrowest bore: the telescoping inner tube 22 / 19.6 (rf2_upper; outer tubes 25 / 22.4); conductive but 0.6-1.2 m from the coil and no loop around the coil axis

harness.route: one bundle inside the tube; taps leave through grommeted holes at the TXD (S1), REF3 (its 3 pairs) and the pod (DATA, and the pod-pack pairs); HV pairs in their own FEP jackets, twisted with their return; LV and analog pairs in a separate sleeve

echoes.criterion: drift for a 5 K step <= 0.5 x the gate noise; heat sink at worst-case orientation, cans with lateral axes

tx_pair.note: first-order: tail 10.5 us (16.3 - 5.8 us clamp) x (sqrt(1 + dC / 500 pF) - 1); pair capacitance ASSUMED (FEP twisted pair)

ref3_coupling.note: speaker alternative: a 50-turn, 12 mm voice coil at 0.11 A rms (0.1 W into 8 ohm), unshielded upper bound

thermal.note: TXD: switch 6.1 W + driver / shunt about 0.2 W; pack: regenerative buck losses at 90 % (ASSUMED), LMR36520 and cell I2R

runtime.note: powers from rf2_continuous (regenerative clamp, 75 % recovery ASSUMED)
